notes: The general wildlife measures (and, for orders continued from the Forest Practices Code, the objectives) of the ungulate winter range and wildlife habitat area orders read for the Omineca region, as each order's own text states them. Each measure is paraphrased, quoted under 125 characters, and tied to the units or zones the order names. Orders were read from the PDFs the Ministry of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship publishes (https://www.env.gov.bc.ca/wld/frpa/uwr/approved_uwr.html and https://www.env.gov.bc.ca/cgi-bin/apps/faw/wharesult.cgi?search=wlap_region&wlap=Omineca); most are scans, read by OCR and checked against the page images where a reading mattered. A screen, never a legal determination: whether a measure applies to a block, and whether an exemption is granted, is the reviewer's and the ministry's.

orders.title: Ungulate winter range U7-002, mule deer, Fort St. James
orders.authority: Operational and Site Planning Regulation s. 69(1)(a), (b); continued under FRPA ss. 180, 181

measures.says: Keep at least 40% of each unit in age class 8 or older with crown closure over 56%.
measures.quote: maintain a minimum of 40% of winter range area in age class 8 (> 140 years) or greater at all times

measures.says: Keep at least 50% of stands in age class 8 or older with mature crown closure over 66%.
measures.quote: maintain a minimum of 50% of stands in age class 8 (>140 years) or greater

measures.says: Keep the stands Douglas-fir leading, at least half Douglas-fir.
measures.quote: maintain species composition as Douglas-fir leading, with a minimum of 50% Douglas-fir

measures.says: Keep 10 to 40% shrub cover of preferred deciduous forage, which limits brushing.
measures.quote: maintain 10—40% shrub cover of preferred deciduous forage species

measures.says: No commercial harvesting in unit 19.
measures.quote: Within UWR Unit number 19, no commercial forest harvesting.

measures.says: Openings irregular, under 1 ha and under 250 m wide.
measures.quote: keep timber harvesting openings irregular in shape, < 1 ha in size and < 250 m wide

measures.says: Avoid winter forestry development, harvesting included, from 15 December to 15 April.
measures.quote: Avoid winter forestry development (including harvesting) between December 15th and April 15th.

measures.says: Reduce conflicts with livestock: no increase in animal unit months and no new tenures.
measures.quote: Do not increase Animal Unit Month (AUM) allotments or issue new tenures.

measures.says: Lowest practicable road class, major routes planned round the range, and new road matched 1:1 by permanent deactivation.
measures.quote: permanently deactivating roads in a 1:1 ratio to the amount of new road construction

measures.says: No new roads in unit 19.
measures.quote: Within UWR Unit number 19, do not construct any new roads.

orders.title: Ungulate winter range U-7-003, mountain caribou, Upper Fraser, Hart Ranges and Mount Robson

measures.says: Primary forest activities must leave at least 20% of each unit's forest older than 100 years, as a contiguous windfirm corridor.
measures.quote: Primary forest activities will result in a minimum of 20% of the forest within each unit as greater than 100 years of age

measures.says: No more than 20% of each unit's productive forest below 3 m green-up at any time.
measures.quote: no more than 20% of the productive forest area of each unit being less than 3 metre green-up condition at any time

measures.says: No timber harvesting or road construction, except as GWMs 2(b)–(d), 4 and 5 provide.
measures.quote: Timber harvesting and road construction must not occur within the UWR except as provided in GWMs 2(b),2 (c), 2(d)

measures.says: Partial cutting only: at most 30% of the volume every 80 years, openings no larger than 1 ha (mean 0.5 ha or less), two tree lengths apart.
measures.quote: Timber harvesting will result in less than or equal to 30% volume removal on a cut block area every 80 years

measures.says: Forest health sanitation without a material adverse impact on caribou habitat.
measures.quote: will be conducted in a manner that does not result in a material adverse impact on the caribou habitat

measures.says: No permanent road within 2 km of a Caribou High unit.
measures.quote: Permanent road access in the Caribou Medium UWR Units will not be constructed within 2 km of any Caribou High UWR Unit.

measures.says: Deactivate roads under FPPR s. 82(1)(a)–(c) once harvesting and silviculture no longer need them; plough snow only for harvesting.
measures.quote: roads will be deactivated as per sections 82(1)(a),(b) and (c) of the Forest Planning and Practices Regulation

exemptions.quote: may occur where cut blocks and associated roads have been previously approved in a Forest Development Plan
exemptions.by: The order itself

exemptions.says: GWM 2(a) does not apply to road construction, maintenance and deactivation through units R-005, P-015, P-024, P-034, P-058 and P-066.
exemptions.quote: GWM 2(a) does not apply to road construction, maintenance and deactivation through UWR units R-005, P-015, P-024
exemptions.by: The order itself

exemptions.says: Road maintenance, deactivation and reclamation are outside GWM 2(a).
exemptions.quote: GWM 2(a) does not apply for the purposes of road maintenance, road deactivation, or road reclamation activities.
exemptions.by: The order itself

exemptions.ref: Appendix 1, item 2 (not part of the order)
exemptions.says: Harvesting or roads that cannot comply need an exemption under FPPR s. 92(1), applied for with a rationale; forest health sanitation needs one where it cannot comply.
exemptions.quote: an exemption is required from the requirement to comply with the GWMs if the activities are to proceed

measures.says: All forest cover retained, except cutblocks and roads authorized when the range was established.

measures.says: No road construction without an exemption; authorized roads are not permanent access structures.
measures.quote: Road construction is not to occur within these ungulate winter range units unless an exemption is approved

exemptions.says: Cutblocks and associated roads authorized when the range was established are outside the retention rule.

exemptions.says: An exemption would be considered to enhance the range; none is needed for danger trees along adjacent cutblock boundaries or for sanitation harvesting.

measures.says: Openings irregular, no larger than 1 ha and under 250 m wide.
measures.quote: keep timber harvesting openings irregular shaped, no greater than 1 ha in size and less than 250 m wide

measures.says: Road length held to what exists by closing roads 1:1 with new construction, snow ploughed only for hauling and silviculture, harvest roads closed and rehabilitated after harvest.

measures.says: No new main road unless there is no practicable option and an exemption is given; a road on the Fort St. James long-term corridor plan needs none.

measures.says: Two-pass, 140-year rotation: each pass harvests 50% ± 20% of the economic timber in one clump, keeping the lichen ratio, within 20 years.

measures.says: When work is done, make non-main roads unfavourable to wolf and snowmobile travel.

measures.says: Harvest lichen habitat in winter with enough snow, and process at roadside.

measures.says: Do not fertilize lichen habitat.

measures.says: Range practices must not convert lichen habitat; no range developments without an exemption; no domestic animals such as sheep without a full risk assessment.

orders.title: Ungulate winter ranges u-7-018, u-7-020, u-7-022, u-7-024 and u-7-027, moose

measures.says: No primary forest activities: no harvesting, silviculture or road work.
measures.quote: No primary forest activities.

measures.says: No livestock attractants and no new range developments.
measures.quote: No Livestock Attractants or new range developments may be placed in the units.

measures.says: No new permanent access within 500 m of a no harvest unit.
measures.quote: No new permanent access structures within 500 metres horizontal distance of a no harvest ungulate winter range unit

measures.says: Net area to be reforested no more than 60 ha, or a cutblock up to 100 ha keeping 40% or more of the basal area.
measures.quote: The net area to be reforested for the cutblock must not exceed 60 hectares

measures.says: No point of the net area to be reforested more than 125 m from a reserve or security cover.
measures.quote: to either a Reserve or Security Cover, must not exceed 125 metres

measures.says: At free growing, one dominant deciduous stem per 100 m² where present, and patches of moose browse or mature deciduous under 1 ha kept.
measures.quote: retain if present, one Dominant deciduous stem per 100 m²

measures.says: Within a year of the commencement date, rehabilitate the ends of temporary access within 300 m of the block and deactivate the rest under FPPR s. 82(1).
measures.quote: deactivate all remaining temporary access structures in accordance with the Forest Planning and Practices Regulation

measures.says: Within four years, rehabilitate the first 100 m of temporary access from the permanent road.
measures.quote: Within four years of the commencement date Rehabilitate the first 100 metres of the temporary access structure

measures.says: Herbicide only against invasive plants and noxious weeds, no brushing within 20 m of the block edge, and moose browse kept where it does not compete with a crop tree.
measures.quote: The use of Herbicide is permitted only for the control of invasive plants and/or Noxious Weeds.

measures.says: An objective the forest stewardship plan answers: a diversity of tree species from an approved stocking standard.
measures.quote: Promote stand heterogeneity by using a diversity of tree species identified in an approved stocking standard.

exemptions.ref: Supplemental document, Exemptions (not part of the order)
exemptions.says: A development inconsistent with the measures needs an exemption under FPPR s. 92(1), judged on its effect on habitat and the steps taken to avoid or mitigate it.
exemptions.quote: they must apply for an exemption under the Forest Planning and Practices Regulation Sec 92(1)
exemptions.by: The minister responsible for the Wildlife Act or delegate
